indexed_primary_leads.title: High-dose spinal cord stimulation for patients with failed back surgery syndrome: a multicenter effectiveness and prediction study
indexed_primary_leads.confirmed: Multicenter registry; 194 recruited; 185 baseline; 92 receiving HD-SCS at 12 months; holistic responder combines pain, medication, ODI and EQ-5D changes at 12 months.
indexed_primary_leads.unresolved: Exact composite thresholds, denominator of prediction analysis and patient-disjoint split need primary full text.

indexed_primary_leads.title: Spinal Cord Stimulation and Patient Selection: Predictive Modeling in a Global Device Registry
locators: NANS 2025 author poster, Methods, Results and Discussion; PDF page 1
Neuromodulation 28(7) Supplement (2025), S209, abstract Methods and Results
indexed_primary_leads.confirmed: Verified primary publisher abstract and author poster: prospective Product Surveillance Registry; 721 back/leg-pain patients; responder is at least a 2-point reduction on a 0-10 pain score at six months; training/test partition 80/20 with repeated five-fold cross-validation in training; predictor types include baseline pain, pain location/type, quality of life and demographics. The poster prose/table discrepancy is retained explicitly. Conference abstract/poster only, not a full methods paper. No ECAP predictor is stated.
indexed_primary_leads.version_discrepancy: The poster prose states 274/363 combined back-and-leg-pain responders. The same poster Table 1 instead reports 267 responders and 96 nonresponders (total 363); the ScienceDirect publisher abstract also reports 267/363 (74%). Preserve this internal poster prose/table discrepancy; 267/363 is the value supported by both the table arithmetic and publisher abstract, but no author correction is asserted.
indexed_primary_leads.unresolved: Prediction-analysis denominators after train/test allocation, patient-level linkage and split implementation, and individual-level dataset access remain unreported/unestablished. Poster Table 2 and Figure 3 contain performance material; exact metric values were not transcribed in this audit. The 274 prose count conflicts with both Table 1 (267 responders, 96 nonresponders) and the publisher abstract (267 responders); do not silently harmonize the poster.

primary_access_review.decision: Repeated primary-source access review on 2026-09-25. No full methods were obtained for S034, S046, S755, or S762. S755 has a BMJ-provided first-page preview on ResearchGate, but visible text ends before Methods. Accessible abstracts support only explicitly reported fields; no thresholds, denominators, linkage, or split are inferred.
